OKX Boost 0.3%, Kraken and Gate 19:00 listings, and Binance Alpha 50,000 slots remain unverified discovery claims.
Bitget verifies 1.25M DOS across Launchpool and CandyBomb; the originating tokenomics bucket and actual reward distribution times remain unknown.
BSC dynamic OFT supply and the exchange-listed Ethereum contract lack an official cross-chain identity mapping and must not be added.
A 200 DOS sell and an exact-200 DOS route cluster are observed after claim start; claim-origin attribution remains unresolved without claim/distributor receipts.
